summary: Hopkins County, KY steel fire lookout put up by the Kentucky Division of Forestry in 1957; now marked Removed, with no removal date or site description found.

facts.design: Four-legged self-supporting steel tower with an observation room at the top, painted gray
facts.status_note: Marked Removed on the Forest Lookouts page; no source gives a removal date or describes the site today

notes_for_editor: Every source is a quotation on one fan site (Forest Lookouts); the 1957 newspaper and the 1962 survey description were not read directly. The removal date, method and current site condition are unknown; two web searches found nothing more. The NGS text gives the station as about 3 1/2 miles north of Dawson Springs and 1 1/4 miles west-southwest of Charleston; the record's coordinates were not checked against that. The 1957 article's 'id' typo is quoted as printed. Staffing, fires and access are not in the sources and are left out. The Charleston tower and the old Beulah lookout are described as separate structures.
